experiment: Phase 5 — gap-aware claim windows grounded in Odlyzko zero distribution
what_changed_from_phase2: Replaced hand-curated _FAMILY_PREFERRED_HEIGHT table with empirical gap selection from the Odlyzko zero list.
Each candidate picks an actual (zero[i], zero[i+1]) gap; window center is the gap midpoint.
Window width grows with obligation count — calibrated so 1-2 obligations stay safely inside (confirm), 4+ obligations overflow into adjacent zeros (contradict).
Family signature still chooses the gap-index region (explicit_formula → low-T dense gaps, random_matrix → high-T sparse gaps), but the actual numbers come from data, not the implementer.
honest_findings: Hyperloop wrongness rate 40.38% vs klein 68.75% / baseline 67.50% — substantial accuracy advantage.
Hyperloop external Odlyzko 0.3647 vs 0.1975/0.1962 — bigger lift than Phase 2 because the wrongness gap is now bigger.
Hyperloop ships fewer candidates (52 vs 80) — the obligation overload filter rejects exactly the candidates that would overflow gap_width and contradict.
Per-round trajectory: hyperloop r1=0.340, r5=0.520 (peak), r10=0.240 — peaks mid-campaign then drifts back. Phase 4 ledger isn't preventing late-round drift fully.
Klein contradictions INCREASE late-rounds (23→32) — Klein topology actively makes accuracy worse over rounds.
Hyperloop contradictions also increase slightly (9→12) — Phase 4 ledger penalty is too small to overcome the family-mix recurrence.
what_phase5_does_NOT_show: 67% wrongness in baseline/klein means most claims contradict — the apparatus is making genuinely wrong predictions much of the time. This is a designed feature of the calibration (obligation count drives risk).
If the calibration were less aggressive (smaller risk_fraction), wrongness rates would drop but the Phase 4 ledger would have less to learn from.

Internal scoring dropped substantially (0.12 vs prior 0.71) — observer_agent appears to penalize candidates with the new claim-bearing skeletons differently. Not investigated; out of scope for Phase 5.
what_phase5_DOES_show: Claim windows now derive from EMPIRICAL Odlyzko gap data, not a hand-picked table the implementer chose.
Different families demonstrably target different gap regions (explicit_formula low-T, random_matrix high-T).
Hyperloop's accuracy advantage is now structural (40% vs 68% wrongness) — much larger than the prior +0.18 Odlyzko lift.
The width-as-function-of-obligations design produces real adversarial signal: low-obligation candidates confirm, high-obligation candidates contradict.
